payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy assignment of painters to planks needing that color, using the last painter's plank as a sink for extras, checking feasibility by ensuring all needed changes are covered and last painter matches a desired color.
payload.rationale: The algorithm iterates painters in order, greedily picks a plank to satisfy each outstanding desired color change. Unassigned painters are later redirected to the last painter's plank, effectively using an exchange argument: any valid assignment can be transformed to this pattern without breaking correctness.
